comparisons.peer_summary: Short-term borrowings primarily consist of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) short-term borrowings, notes payable, and other borrowings with maturities of one year or less. The balance increased by $11.3 billion, driven by higher unsecured borrowings to manage liquidity needs.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Bank of America report increases in short-term borrowings for 2024, but they cite different primary drivers. Citi attributes its 29% increase to higher commercial paper issuances at broker-dealer subsidiaries as part of a funding diversification effort. In contrast, BAC attributes its $11.3 billion increase primarily to higher unsecured borrowings used to manage liquidity needs, with its short-term borrowings composition highlighting FHLB advances alongside notes payable.

sentences.text: Citi's short-term borrowings of $49 billion as of December 31, 2024 increased 29% year-over-year, reflecting higher commercial paper issuances at the broker-dealer subsidiaries, as Citi continues to diversify its funding profile, and increased 17% sequentially, driven by the commercial paper issuances and normal business activity (see Note 19 for further information on Citigroup's and its affiliates' outstanding short-term borrowings).

Short-term borrowings provide an additional funding source and primarily consist of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) short-term borrowings, notes payable and various other borrowings that generally have maturities of one year or less.
Short-term borrowings increased $11.3 billion primarily due to higher unsecured borrowings to manage liquidity needs.

comparisons.peer_summary: Unsecured short-term borrowings include long-term debt maturing within one year, hybrid instruments, and commercial paper used to finance liquid assets. Group Inc. does not issue short-term debt directly, other than to subsidiaries, in compliance with regulatory requirements.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs utilize commercial paper as a component of their short-term borrowing strategies to support liquidity and asset financing. Citi explicitly increased commercial paper issuances at its broker-dealer subsidiaries to diversify its funding profile. Similarly, Goldman Sachs uses unsecured short-term borrowings, which include commercial paper and hybrid instruments, to finance liquid assets and for cash management purposes, noting that its parent company does not issue short-term debt directly to subsidiaries.

sentences.text: Citi's short-term borrowings of $49 billion as of December 31, 2024 increased 29% year-over-year, reflecting higher commercial paper issuances at the broker-dealer subsidiaries, as Citi continues to diversify its funding profile, and increased 17% sequentially, driven by the commercial paper issuances and normal business activity (see Note 19 for further information on Citigroup's and its affiliates' outstanding short-term borrowings).
We use unsecured short-term borrowings, including U.S. and non-U.S. hybrid financial instruments and commercial paper, to finance liquid assets and for other cash management purposes.
In accordance with regulatory requirements, Group Inc. does not issue debt with an original maturity of less than one year, other than to its subsidiaries.

comparisons.peer_topic: Unsecured short-term funding sources and activity
comparisons.peer_summary: Primary short-term unsecured funding sources include wholesale commercial paper and other borrowed funds. Average commercial paper decreased in 2024 due to lower issuances from short-term liquidity management, while unsecured other borrowed funds increased at year-end 2024, primarily driven by net issuances of structured notes in Markets.
comparisons.comparison: While both Citi and JPMorgan reference commercial paper and other borrowed funds as short-term funding sources, their 2024 trends diverged. Citi experienced a 29% year-over-year increase in short-term borrowings driven by higher commercial paper issuances. Conversely, JPMorgan reported that average commercial paper decreased due to lower issuances for short-term liquidity management, although it did see an increase in unsecured other borrowed funds driven by structured notes.

sentences.text: Citi's short-term borrowings of $49 billion as of December 31, 2024 increased 29% year-over-year, reflecting higher commercial paper issuances at the broker-dealer subsidiaries, as Citi continues to diversify its funding profile, and increased 17% sequentially, driven by the commercial paper issuances and normal business activity (see Note 19 for further information on Citigroup's and its affiliates' outstanding short-term borrowings).
The Firm's primary sources of short-term unsecured funding consist of issuances of wholesale commercial paper and other borrowed funds.
The decrease in average commercial paper for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the prior year period was due to lower issuances primarily as a result of short-term liquidity management.
The increase in unsecured other borrowed funds at December 31, 2024 from December 31, 2023, was predominantly driven by net issuances of structured notes in Markets.
